mobility.title: Foreign employment
mobility.subtitle: Verify workers' travel documents and clearances, and keep recruitment-agency licences in check.
mobility.rule: KaamSathi never recruits or matches for jobs abroad. Workers only share the verification status of their documents with a DoFE-licensed agency they choose.

agencies.name: Agency
agencies.days_left: {days, plural, =0 {expires today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
agencies.empty_body: Add the agency as a partner of kind "Recruitment agency" first, then verify its DoFE licence here.
agencies.dialog_verify_body: Check the licence number and validity on the official DoFE website before you verify. Workers can share documents only with verified agencies whose licence has not expired.
agencies.dialog_suspend_body: A suspended agency immediately loses read access, even for shares workers already gave. Workers can no longer choose it.
agencies.note_required: Record why the agency is suspended.
agencies.date_required: Choose a licence expiry date that is today or later.
